extension.reloadTheVSCodeWindowToApplyAl.en: Reload the VS Code window to apply AlwayGit runtime configuration changes.
extension.reloadTheVSCodeWindowToApplyAl.zh-CN: 请重新加载 VS Code 窗口，以应用 AlwayGit 运行时配置更改。

extension.alwayGitActivatedGitOperations.en: AlwayGit activated. Git operations run in the workspace extension host.
extension.alwayGitActivatedGitOperations.zh-CN: AlwayGit 已激活。Git 操作在工作区扩展宿主中运行。
